symbolIds.description: 1..16 distinct exact method addresses from the selected publication. Reports observed operations and supported bound call paths, never purity or actual runtime dispatch.

profileScope.description: Committed profile; defaults to the retained profile. Another committed profile uses the existing verified ephemeral operation-fact lane, not an additional retained base.

maxDepth.description: Maximum supported direct/local call depth, 0..8; default 4. Unexpanded calls remain explicit unknowns.

maxMethods.description: Maximum candidate memberships and reached callables, 1..256 and at least the root count; default 128. Scope exhaustion remains explicit.

maxFacts.description: One shared hard budget for operation and callable-declaration facts, 1..100000; default 10000.

maxEvidencePerMethod.description: Maximum samples per evidence category per root, 0..64; default 16. Observed counts and unknown reasons remain available when samples are capped.

snapshotId.description: Optional exact-publication selection. When present, the tool leases this retained current or graph-only historical snapshot instead of silently reading latest. Historical selections do not retain Roslyn services, so compilation-required tools return their normal unavailable-state result.

expectedSnapshotId.description: Optional optimistic-read precondition. The tool runs only when the leased publication has this exact `snap_<32 lowercase hex>` identity; mismatch returns a structured retryable result without silently reading latest.

expectedAnalysisGeneration.description: Optional optimistic-read precondition. The tool runs only when the leased publication has this process-local generation; mismatch returns expected/actual identity and retry guidance.
